crossRefs.note: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as…
For indeed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come…
Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
translations.bsb: In the morning when Nabal was sober, his wife told him about these events, and his heart failed within him, and he became like a stone.
translations.kjv: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, that his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
